dedupe_keys.name: crash and disengagement data of autonomous vehicles on public roads in california

description: Crash and disengagement data of autonomous vehicles on public roads in California is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Amolika Sinha et al. Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) are being widely tested on public roads in several countries such as the USA, Canada, France, Germany, and Australia. For the transparent deployment of AVs in California, the California Department of Motor Vehicles (CA DMV) commissioned AV manufacturers to draft and publish reports on disengagements and crashes. Coverage: several countries (US, CA, FR, DE); published in 2021. Formats: CSV, Excel, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 149720644 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
